title: Came missing a handle.
text: Came missing a handle.. Product looks great. No complaints there. However, the box arrived partially opened and one of the cabinets was missing its top handle. Not too thrilled about that. Will ask for a replacement.

product_metadata.title: Sterilite 26306P02 Decorative 3-Drawer Storage Weave Tower, Espresso
features: Outside Dimensions: 15" D x 12 5/8" W x 24" H
Espresso frame and drawers with driftwood handles
Easy pull handles allow drawers to open and close effortlessly
Versatile decorative storage solution is ideal for use throughout the home
description: The 3 Drawer Weave Tower is the ideal decorative solution for visible storage needs. The three opaque drawers keep clutter controlled and concealed while providing access to frequently used items. Easy pull handles allow drawers to open and close effortlessly. The stylish weave pattern and rich Espresso color of the 3 Drawer Weave Tower provides a furniture-like look in easy to clean, durable plastic.
